planned_formal_claims.proposition_scope: Deterministic canonical encoding and closed rejection conditions over an explicit finite serialization model.
Submission and activation are impossible until all three layers and verified retrieval agree; any required failure preserves the pre-submission state.
Exact successor grant transition preserves A, adds B once, binds exact prepared material, advances revision, consumes replay, and preserves the entire state on every modeled rejection.
Submitted and confirmed observations cannot activate; only matching finalized state plus current verified retrieval can activate exact material.
Policy-scoped reissue changes only B's envelope after replacement readiness and preserves the old envelope and protected state on every modeled failure.
Knowledge consideration remains zero and distinct typed network and storage cost observations cannot become protocol consideration fields.

formal gate theorem, accepted Rust behavior, and real provider-neutral SQL three-layer retrieval evidence all pass

successor theorem, accepted Rust tests, and local Solana instruction/account transition evidence agree on the exact post-state
all modeled and executable signer, revision, duplicate, policy, commitment, replay, and readiness failures preserve exact pre-state
formal and local gates reject submitted and confirmed states, and one authorized Devnet observation proves finalized matching state plus retrieval activates
B retrieves and decrypts exact source bytes with selected suites while structural and executable evidence show secrets never enter chain or evidence fields
theorem and executable evidence agree that authorized fulfillment after readiness changes only B's envelope and B decrypts with the replacement key
all unauthorized, stale, self-fulfillment, mismatch, replay, and storage-failure cases preserve old envelope and protected state
formal zero-consideration and type-separation theorem, structural audit, and exact Devnet network/storage observations agree
all listed predecessor obligations have accepted evidence and one separately authorized exact Devnet trial closes their shared D65 identities
a selected independent reviewer evaluates exact production cryptography, custody, storage, dependencies, zeroization, side channels, and threat boundaries with all supporting evidence current
